Hi Olga,

Thanks for sending the redline. Legal here reviewed the security exhibit and we have two practical asks before we can sign:

1) Pen-test notice window — we can accept a 30-day notice but only if the customer can propose a 2-week immutable window (to coordinate ops). Would Redwood accept a 14-day locked staging window once notice is provided?

2) Evidence cadence — we need a quarterly evidence package for our SOC 2 review. Can you confirm what artifacts Redwood will deliver (e.g., SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, config snapshots)? If you can attach an evidence matrix, that would speed approvals.

We attached our standard procurement checklist as a reference. I know you flagged some of these earlier; want to get alignment before legal issues final redlines.

Olga / all,

Quick take from sales/assurance side. Proposed compromise language for the pen-test clause: "Customer may provide written notice of intent to conduct a penetration test. Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide a 14-calendar-day reserved window for staging or inspection once notice is accepted; for multi-tenant Dedicated pools this will be scheduled within 30 days of notice and may be subject to a mutually agreed scope to avoid service disruption."

Rationale: keeps us from promising an absolute immutable block if we have reserved pools shared across customers, but it gives Lumina the predictability they want.

On evidence cadence: attached is an evidence_matrix.xlsx draft — includes quarterly bundles: SOC 2 report (latest), pen-test executive summary (redacted), role-based access list (snapshots), RPO/RTO statements, and audit logs export (sample extracts). We can commit to quarterly delivery for documentation and ad-hoc access for deeper dives with an NDA and short notice (5 business days).

Laura — please confirm legal ok on the wording above or propose edits. Karthik — flag any operational blockers on the 14-day reserved window.

— Ben

Attachments: evidence_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan Ortiz <megan.ortiz@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit redlines — a couple of calendar/notice questions

Short ops note — 14-day reserved window is feasible for Dedicated customers who have dedicated GPU pools or private deployments. For Hosted/shared capacity customers we cannot guarantee an immutable 14-day exclusive window; instead we can offer: a) a 14-day scheduled window with limited isolation guarantees (we'll snapshot KV/cache and schedule traffic routing to minimize impact), or b) an option for Lumina to upgrade to a short-term dedicated reservation (30-day min) to get a true isolated window.

Impact: if Lumina plans to insist on a hard lock for a shared-hosted deployment, there could be a cost and scheduling implication. I recommend we include the upgrade option in the order form (one-time reservation fee + prorated capacity).

If Lumina agrees to the scheduled-window language, ops can accept the clause as Ben drafted and we provide an appendix in the evidence_matrix that documents exactly what "scheduled" vs "reserved" means operationally.

Karthik
VP, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

1) We'll accept the "scheduled 14-day window" language for our Hosted deployment as long as the order form includes the upgrade path to a short-term dedicated reservation and the pricing estimate. We need the pricing line to be explicit for procurement.

2) Evidence cadence looks good; please include a sample SOC 2 redacted report and the evidence matrix in your package. Our InfoSec lead will want the pen-test executive summary redacted for high-level findings only.

Next steps requested: Olga — can you send updated MSA redline with Ben's suggested clause plus an appendix in the order form that lists the upgrade pricing and the quarterly evidence bundle? If you can get that by EOD Thursday our procurement team will start the internal signoff loop.

If easier, let's schedule a 30-min call Thursday AM to close language and pricing.

Best,
Megan
